sourcePolicy: Slideshow artifacts are presentation-data derivatives of approved theory-core and theory-reference files. They may reorganize learning beats but may not add mathematics or contradict sources.
rules: A slideshow file requires approved core and reference source versions.
Each slide must have one primary learning beat and source traceability.
Formulas must include meaning or application conditions in the slide context.
Diagram specifications must be semantic and must not contain CSS, pixel placement, colors or animation instructions.
Misconception intercepts and retrieval checks must appear near the relevant learning beat.
Worked-case values must match the approved core exactly.
Slideshow files must not contain renderer code, runtime wiring or Reader Pro changes.
Downstream full-view and integration work may consume slideshow data but may not override core meaning.
